belongs_in_method_template: canonical method phase vocabulary and ordering
stage purposes and minimum structured inputs and outputs
completion signals that let downstream systems validate methodological coverage
source-of-truth boundaries for neighboring campaign, evidence, continuation, and budget systems
outside_method_template: campaign execution lifecycle state and append-only run history
evidence pack payload contents and source provenance bodies
continuation packet payloads for concrete future handoff state
budget-adaptive rigor policy or runtime effort tuning

forbidden_top_level_fields.campaign_execution_record: Method templates may link campaign records but may not embed execution truth.
forbidden_top_level_fields.campaign_record_body: Campaign record bodies remain owned by the campaign execution contract.
forbidden_top_level_fields.evidence_pack_payload: Evidence-pack contents remain canonical in evidence-pack artifacts.
forbidden_top_level_fields.continuation_packet_payload: Continuation packet payloads remain canonical in continuation artifacts.
forbidden_top_level_fields.budget_adaptive_rigor_policy: Budget-adaptive rigor policy belongs to the separate IS-14 workstream.
forbidden_top_level_fields.prompt_prose_template: Prompt prose may explain a template but never replaces the structured template contract.
forbidden_top_level_fields.template_summary_only: A prose summary alone is not a machine-readable method template.

forbidden_phase_fields.evidence_pack_body: Phase rows may link evidence packs later, but may not inline pack payload bodies.
forbidden_phase_fields.continuation_packet_body: Phase rows may declare continuation obligations, but may not inline packet payloads.
forbidden_phase_fields.execution_state: Execution state belongs to campaign execution records, not to method templates.
forbidden_phase_fields.budget_policy_override: Budget-adaptive rigor remains outside the method-template contract.
forbidden_phase_fields.prompt_text: Prompt text is advisory prose, not canonical method-template structure.
